blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —FPJ Panday Bayanihan Rep. Brian Poe is asking civil society budget monitors to the government identify programs with unused funds and to check whether the House of Representatives had chosen appropriate sources for proposed realignments in the 2027 national budget. According to a statement issued on Tuesday, Poe raised the request during a press conference on Monday with House political party leaders at the Romualdez Hall. His appeal covered both the projects receiving funds and the programs lawmakers had identified as possible funding sources.
